notes: Reference date 2018-01-01. First coded in January 2019 (2019-01-29), after the 2017-18 academic year; the provisions counted rest on documents in force on 2018-01-01 or of uncertain date (flagged version_uncertain).

Governing document on the reference date 2018-01-01: University Policy 2230 'Parental Leave for Instructional 9-month Faculty' (2018_01; approved 10/22/2015, revised 12/12/2017), coded as c11 and c12. Its successor, University Policy 2230 'Faculty Paid Parental Leave' (2018_00; approved 12/13/2018, 'This policy will become effective January 1, 2019'; the saved capture shows 'Revised: 4/2/2019'), is coded as c1-c3 and flagged not_yet_effective (V5).

Which form of Work Relief Combination applies is arranged 'in partnership with their department'; it is coded as the faculty member's election (V2: 'can elect'), so the 100% semester (c11) is guaranteed on request. Read instead as set jointly with the department, the guaranteed benefit would be one semester of relief-equivalent of unstated form; the weeks would not change.

Faculty Handbook: the saved edition is July 1, 2017 (2018_04); 2018_03 is the BOV-approved 2017 revision document whose final text matches the July 2017 edition for the sections it covers (its 2.7.3.2 final text is identical to 2018_04). The 2017 Policy 2230 cites Handbook section 2.7.3.1 and Policy 2232 cites 2.7.3.2, both in the July 2017 edition, from which c9 and c10 are coded; only the 2019 successor policy cites a later section 2.7.4.

Calendar: the Handbook states the kind of term (Fall and Spring semesters; academic-year appointments 'from two weeks prior to the beginning of classes in the Fall semester until two weeks after the end of classes in the Spring semester'); no length in weeks, so R8 semester default 16.

Paths by plan enrollment (U8): faculty are either VSDP participants (short-term disability for medical recovery after birth, c5) or Traditional Sick Leave participants (accrued sick leave, c7). The documents do not say which plan the reference member is in; both are coded with a restriction flag. Neither counts in the 2018-definition figure.

Birth parent chain (9-month faculty): VSDP short-term disability (c5, length not stated; VSDP participants) concurrent with the Parental Leave, one semester at 100% relief (c11) or 50% over two semesters (c12), in lieu of each other; FMLA (c4) concurrent from the start. Traditional-plan members are charged accrued sick leave (c7), unlinked.
Non-birth parent chain (9-month faculty): Parental Leave, c11 or c12 in lieu of each other, with FMLA (c4) concurrent from the start.

Leave without pay and 'personal leave' are named only as ways to cover time within FMLA beyond PPL or beyond sick-leave balances (Policy 2230 III.A.2.iii/B.2.iv, Policy 2232 III); no separate provision with its own terms, so not coded separately (recorded in c4's duration_note).

Not components: study leave for tenure-track faculty and leave programs for tenured faculty (Handbook 3.6.1-3.6.2) are research/professional-development leaves, not usable for a birth; post-chair study leave (2.12); temporary relief of duties for danger (2.10.9); tenure clock extensions for military service and administrative appointments (2.7.3.3-2.7.3.4).

Documents cited but not saved: DHRM Policy 4.57 and Faculty Handbook section 2.7.4 (both cited only by the 2019 successor policy); University Policy 2215 procedure 'Family Medical Leave Procedure for Faculty under the Traditional Sick Leave Plan' and 'Family and Medical Leave Act Procedures'; HR benefits pages (hr.gmu.edu/benefits, hr.gmu.edu/benefits/leave/fmla.php); Work Relief Plan / Faculty Transaction Form (forms).

FMLA eligibility: Policy 2215 writes '12 months or a minimum of 1250 hours'; the statute (29 U.S.C. 2611(2)(A), saved) requires 12 months and 1,250 hours; Policy 2230 (2018_00 II.A.2) also states 'AND'. Coded from the statute (U2).
